comments.text: There is something about Russia that I find genuinely difficult to put into words. 🇷🇺❤️ It is not just the breathtaking architecture, the beautiful streets, the fascinating history, or the incredible scale of the country. It is the feeling that there is an entire world waiting to be discovered, with its own traditions, language, way of life, and countless stories hidden in every city. The more videos I watch, the more curious I become about what everyday life in Russia is really like beyond what we see on the internet. I love discovering the little details that make a country unique, from the way people spend their evenings to the atmosphere of its streets during different seasons. Russia seems to have a character and identity of its own, and I would love to understand it beyond the perspective of a visitor. ❤️ Your video is another beautiful reminder of just how much there is to explore and learn about this remarkable country. 🇷🇺 If you had the chance to show someone only one side of Russia, something that would make them understand why this country is so special to you, what would you choose? I would genuinely love to know your perspective.

comments.author: @koechleonardkibet6757
comments.text:
What an escapade of a documentary! 

Lately, I have been following more content about Russia, and that is how I discovered this channel. What fascinates me most is how Russia has explored and developed the Arctic, turning one of the harshest environments on Earth into places where people can actually live and work.
The more I learn, the more interesting Russia’s geography and global presence become. From Kaliningrad, the Russian exclave surrounded by EU territory, to Russia’s long-standing presence in Svalbard, particularly Barentsburg, under the Svalbard Treaty, there is so much history that many of us outside Russia know very little about.
Then there are the complicated geopolitical stories of Abkhazia and South Ossetia in Georgia and Transnistria in Moldova. It really makes you appreciate how unique Russia’s geography, history and strategic interests are.
As an African watching from Kenya, I find these stories incredibly fascinating.
Big thumbs up to this channel! Keep bringing us these documentaries and showing the world the Russia that many people rarely get to see. 👏
